newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 11.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Fair Trade Commission (FTC) asks Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to cut its stake in NTT Mobile Communications Network Inc (NTT DoCoMo).
-- Finance Ministry and Bank of Japan plan market intervention to stop yen's fall.
-- Lower House to approve revised special law on Okinawa today. Feasibility study on heliport to start this month.
-- Ajinomoto Co Inc President Shunsuke Inamori to resign.
-- Okinawa Governor Masahide Ota reluctantly consents to feasibility study for heliport in Nago, Okinawa Prefecture.
-- Prosecutors to probe false report by Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corporation (PNC).
